comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Tech Rank: 1
Consumed Gauge: 30
Range: 100
Shatter Range: 45

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it requires just one second before the activation.

Effect:
Aside from damage, the target(s) get burned and lose -15 stamina per second. The effect last for 10 second. Higher Trap prolongs the duration.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Level 1 trap techs can be learned fighting any enemy in the world in a Landing Zone or Dungeon, so long as you have the skill requirements. It just might take a few tries (unless you use that Astro item which enables quick tech acquisition for a limited time).

I personally picked this and several others up in the Syracuse Dungeon while using Explosive items (sold in town at the Pedlar) to KO the boss and any other strong-ish for beginner player enemies as needed.
